Think out loud. No draft needed.

Ums, slips and changes of mind get cleaned up for you.

  1. What you said

    So, um, I think the, uh, the new build is ready for testing, you know.

    What gets typed

    I think the new build is ready for testing.

  2. What you said

    Let’s meet at ten, no, actually make it eleven tomorrow.

    What gets typed

    Let’s meet at 11 tomorrow.

  3. What you said

    Check the cooper netties config before we deploy.

    What gets typed

    Check the Kubernetes config before we deploy.

Illustrative. Real results depend on the speech model and the AI model you choose.

Write the prompt, get the text you want.

Four built-in presets with their full prompts open to edit, or write a new one from scratch.

  • Every built-in prompt is visible. Change any line.
  • Write your own: commit messages, translation, an email tone.
  • Give a preset a shortcut and switch any time.

Self-host it for your team or company.

The server is open source and runs on your own machine. The whole team shares one, and audio and text never leave your network.

  • One Docker Compose command
  • Teammates just enter its address
  • Concurrency limits and quotas built in

$ cd SayIt/server

AI cleanup

How AI cleans up recognized text: the switch, prompt presets and per-app rules.

AI cleanupAutomatically clean up dictation, fix typos and tidy word order
Hotwords in the promptPass your hotwords to the AI so it gets them right too.

Cleanup styles

Pick or customize how AI handles your dictation.

  • Intent cleanupBuilt-inYou refine dictated text. The input is a raw speech-recognition transcript; turn it into clear, accurate and concise text. Edit it here. It applies right away.
  • Faithful proofreadBuilt-inYou proofread dictation faithfully. Fix recognition errors, formatting and technical terms while keeping the speaker’s wording and tone. Edit it here. It applies right away.
  • Chinese to EnglishBuilt-inThe input is a Chinese transcript. First fix recognition errors in Chinese, then translate it faithfully into natural English. Edit it here. It applies right away.
  • ConversationalBuilt-inKeep it sounding like speech. Only remove obvious fillers and repetition. Edit it here. It applies right away.

Settings

Interface language

Changes only the app interface. Recognition language is set separately.

Keyboard shortcuts

Press Esc while recording or processing to cancel. Nothing is inserted, and the recording isn’t kept.

Hands-freeBest for talking at length: press once to start, press again to stop. Nothing to hold down.
Push to talkBest for short bursts: recording starts once the whole combination is held down, and stops as soon as you release any key.

Restore the clipboard after insertingPuts your previous clipboard content back once the text is inserted

Common problems

The transcript wasn’t inserted after recognition finished
  1. Click the text box first so the cursor sits inside it.
  2. Don’t switch windows while holding the shortcut: the cursor must still be in the text box when you release it.
  3. Nothing works anywhere: security software is usually the cause. Add SayIt to its trusted list.
  4. Games and installers fail: they run as administrator, so run SayIt as administrator too.
  5. Only one app fails: SayIt can’t recognize its text box yet. Use the copy button on the card to grab the text.

Still stuck? Use "Report a problem" below and pick "Text not inserted".

Questions, answered.

Is it free?

Yes. SayIt is free and open source, with no account to create. Only in Cloud API mode do you pay, and then you pay your provider directly for what you use.

Are my recordings kept?

Your history and recordings stay on your own PC. In Local mode the audio never leaves it; in Cloud API mode it goes straight to your provider; in Server mode the server recognizes it and does not keep it.

Is there a Mac or phone version?

Mac, yes: it needs Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later, and the dmg is on GitHub. There is no phone version yet.

Do I have to replace my keyboard or input method?

No. SayIt only takes a shortcut. Keep typing as you do now, and press the shortcut when you want to talk.

Does it work in Claude Code, Codex and Kiro?

Yes. Text lands at the cursor, so terminals, IDEs, browsers and chat apps all work. The built-in conversational preset is made for instructing AI tools, and presets can switch per app.

How does the shortcut work?

Press Right Alt once to start and again to finish, and the cleaned-up text is typed for you. You can also set a separate hold-to-talk key, and either one can be another key or a mouse side button. On a Mac the defaults are Right ⌘ to start and finish, and Right ⌥ to hold and talk.

Do I need a powerful PC?

No, and no GPU either. Server mode and Cloud API mode ask nothing of your PC. Local mode runs on the CPU and uses a GPU when there is one.

Which languages does it understand?

English, Chinese and a mix of the two all work well. For other languages it depends on the model: Nemotron 3.5 on your PC covers 32, and cloud providers such as OpenAI and Gemini cover more.

How do we run it inside our company?

Set up one NVIDIA GPU server with 16 GB of VRAM or more and start it with one Docker Compose command. Teammates enter its address under Voice engine → Server mode.

How does it compare with Typeless or Wispr Flow?

It does the same job. They are subscription cloud services; SayIt is free and open source, lets you write your own prompts, and can recognize speech on your computer or your company’s network. It runs on Windows and Mac.

Press Right Alt. Say it.

Free for Windows 10 and 11, and macOS 14 or later.
